**Building the future of live entertainment** — you're not watching, you're
in it. Living worlds an audience helps shape, piloted into any place: a
venue, a live stream, a home.

Infinite Spaces is a marketplace for living worlds. Creators author participatory experiences in Playbox — worlds an audience helps shape — and run them live in venues, streams, and homes. A two-person crew produces what used to take a full production team.

Turning real people and real spaces into photorealistic 3D in seconds. The full path from multi-camera capture to a trained Gaussian splat to a real-time renderable asset — and back out to an LED wall while the show is still running. How you capture not just a frozen pose but motion (4D). How you compress, stream, and render millions of splats at frame rate without dropping below show cadence. The arc from a fan standing in a capture volume to their photorealistic avatar on stage in under a minute.

## What You'll Do

What you'll ship in your first 90 days: The 4DGS capture-to-render pipeline — a fan captured from multi-angle input becomes a photorealistic 3D avatar, deployable to a live show in under 60 seconds and rendering at show cadence. (Owns the volumetric pipeline that Role 3 previously listed as a differentiator.)

## What We're Looking For

- 3D Gaussian Splatting / radiance fields — deep with 3DGS and 4DGS (and the NeRF lineage); can train, optimize, and deploy splat models, not just run reference implementations
- Volumetric capture — multi-camera rig design, calibration, photogrammetry, point-cloud/mesh reconstruction; understands the physical capture side, not only the algorithm
- Real-time splat rendering — can get millions of Gaussians rendering at frame rate on target hardware; comfortable in CUDA/GPU compute, custom rasterization, WGSL/Vulkan
- Pipeline systems thinking — owns the end-to-end path capture → train → compress → stream → render and reasons about the quality/latency tradeoff at each stage
- Can describe the pipeline precisely enough for AI to scaffold the glue, and move across capture hardware, ML training, and render code

Adjacent experience that signals: Photogrammetry tooling, point-cloud processing, codecs/streaming for volumetric data, CUDA kernels, differentiable rendering, real-time engine integration (Unreal/Unity/custom), capture-stage / virtual-production experience
